{"notes": "VISIT 5 (left 8:15). Heard only the facilitator's 2-minute warning. I saw no one's hands or actions this visit, and no hand labels were on the table, so I have nothing new to credit or fault for any individual. The fish is fully dark and connected: body, lower fork to ~(28,13.2), and upper lobe including the tip near (27-29, 7-8). The belly double line near (13-16, 14) is dense but connected. Whether it falls as one piece only the push will show. I still can't say who placed what.

TOM: At 6:15 he found the break at the bend and asked Leo whether to fix it or leave it to him, so he checked in rather than overriding. Collaboration is strong (4 observations) and leadership is plausible. Still unknown whether he placed the fix himself. Nothing new.

PRIYA: At 6:30 she correctly said the whole run falls from the start, including the lower fork, and asked people not to touch it before the push. That was accurate and protected the build. Reliable, clear communicator, positive on leadership. Nothing new.

MAYA: Nothing seen. Earlier she misheard Priya's handover and called the lobe 'done' while the tip was pale, though she did go and check joins. Ask her privately what she placed.

LEO: Nothing seen. His earlier flag of the break was real. I never saw a reply to Tom's question at 6:15, and his claim to have fixed anything is unverified. Ask him privately.

NEXT: Watch the push. Ask Leo and Maya privately what they placed. Don't rate build credit for anyone until I have evidence."}
